name: Spring Recall
description: Draw from the spring of life itself to start the heart of a fallen ally and hold it.

name: Wellhead Cleansing
description: Cleanse a deep curse or taint from an ally with water drawn from the source of life.

name: Springwater Renewal
description: Pour a bright renewal like fresh spring water over a group of the wounded until every cut shuts.

name: Springburst
description: Burst the pent spring of vitality outward to hammer every foe in a wide circle.

name: Headspring Return
description: Return a fallen ally through the headspring of life so breath and pulse come back whole.

name: Headspring Renewal
description: Renew every ally in the field from the headspring until even the oldest scars begin to soften.

name: Spring Veil
description: Hang a veil of spring water over the group that nullifies poison and curse as they approach.

name: Spring Lance
description: Spear a column of the first spring through shield and mail and flood the body behind them.

name: Primal Grace
description: Grant the school's primal grace to the gravely hurt so wounds close as if first made whole.

name: Primeval Return
description: Return the lately dead with the school's primal call inside the short window and hold them.

name: First Flood
description: Loose the first flood of living water over an entire host and mend every wound within its reach.

name: First Spring
description: Open the spring from which all living things first rose and hold the moment of death open so a fallen ally walks back whole.

name: Green Recall
description: Recall a fallen ally on a rising green pulse that does not stop until the heart carries on alone.

name: Wither Unmaking
description: Unmake a withering curse from an ally by pouring green life through every place it has gripped.

name: Evergreen Turn
description: Turn the body on an evergreen swell of vitality that sheds even a master's blow.

name: Verdant Spear
description: Drive a spear of verdant force through the target's guard and leave its strength drained.

name: Deathless Recall
description: Recall the fallen with a deathless call that carries across a wide field inside the short window.

name: Deathless Renewal
description: Renew the whole line of battle with a deathless wave that closes wounds as quickly as they open.

name: Verdant Aegis
description: Raise a bastion of green force about the group that holds against repeated crushing blows.

name: Verdant Quake
description: Heave a quake of verdant force outward that tears at everything within reach of the user.

name: Greenbound Grace
description: Grant the school's greenbound grace to the hurt so deep wounds close and the weak are filled with strength.

name: Greenbound Return
description: Return the newly fallen with the school's greenbound call inside the short window and bind the heart to its beat.

name: Greenbound Cleansing
description: Cleanse curse and poison from all the school's allies with a single greenbound sweep.

name: Verdure Restoration
description: Restore an entire host and the ground beneath it with a verdure that spreads as far as the eye can see.

name: Overgreen Ruin
description: Unleash an overgrowth of raw vitality that buries a whole army in surging force and breaks its ranks.

name: Unending Verdure
description: Raise an unending verdure that heals a ruined land and all its people and keeps them whole after the casting ends.

name: Deathless Spring
description: Hold the moment of death open so the departing life of a fallen comrade is called back whole.
